notes.title: Small Update & Controller Support Info
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!
[/p][p]I wanted to share a quick update and address some ongoing issues with controller support.
[/p][p]First, regarding controller issues: I’ve seen a lot of reports, and I’m actively working on a fix. In the meantime, a common solution is to [b]disable Steam Input[/b] in your Steam settings — this resolves the issue in most cases. So if your controller isn't working, please check that Steam Input is turned off.[/p][p]
Also, I just made a small update:

-Added a new item[/p][p]-Improved the stamina system slightly[/p][p]-Fixed a few minor bugs[/p][p]

Thanks for your support, and have a great day![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Awita: Journey of Hope is Available Now
notes.content: [p]After a long and heartfelt development journey spanning over two years, [i]Awita: Journey of Hope[/i] is finally here, now available on Steam![/p][p]What began as a passion project has grown into an epic side-scrolling metroidvania adventure. Join Awita, a courageous young girl fighting to save her village from a devastating epidemic. Explore a vast, hand-crafted kingdom, engage in fluid sword combat, and uncover a world steeped in rich mythology and lore.[/p][p]This has been a journey filled with challenges, creativity, and dedication, and we’re beyond excited to finally share it with you.[/p][p]Start playing today and experience the hope that inspired it all.[/p]

notes.title: Awita: Journey of Hope launches June 18 on Steam!
notes.content:
After two years of development, we're thrilled to announce that Awita: Journey of Hope will officially release on Steam on June 18, 2025!

Embark on an epic side-scrolling metroidvania adventure as Awita, a courageous young girl determined to save her village from a devastating epidemic. Traverse an expansive kingdom, engage in dynamic sword combat, and uncover rich lore and mythology.

Add it to your wishlist and ensure you don't miss out on this epic journey!

notes.title: Awita: Journey of Hope became the winner at Indie Cup Ukraine'24
notes.content: We are excited to share that Awita: Journey of Hope won the Creators‘ Choice and Rising Star awards at Indie Cup Ukraine’24. Many thanks to the festival organizers and the jury!

notes.title: 1.0.1 update: critical bugs fixed, and some small changes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Here are some updates.

1) Critical bugs were fixed, and now the game is more playable
2) Some controls were changed to make gameplay more comfortable
3) Boss behavior was changed a bit
4) Made tutorials more visible sacrificing the look because a lot of people didn't pay attention to them
5) Some dialogs were changed
6) Shield mechanic was simplified


If you have any feedback, I would be grateful to hear it.
